question: What lineage of transmission conveys this teaching to the mountain daughter?
premises: Brahmā formerly gave it to us
The speaker now gives it to the addressee
The addressee is the mountain daughter
inference: The teaching was transmitted from Brahmā to the speaker and now from the speaker to the mountain daughter.
plain_english: Formerly Brahmā gave it to us, and I give it to you, O mountain daughter.
